name: Red Tip Farms
description: In Meansville, GA, Red Tip Farms raises Blueberries, Blackberries, Honey, and Eggs on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
